## D2. neuron_id range and float64 round-trip

| dataset   |   n_ids |             min_id |             max_id | max_id > 2^53   |   ids changed by int64->float64->int64 |   distinct ids |   distinct after float64 |   ids lost to collisions |
|:----------|--------:|-------------------:|-------------------:|:----------------|---------------------------------------:|---------------:|-------------------------:|-------------------------:|
| fafb      |  139255 | 720575940596125868 | 720575940661339777 | True            |                                 138123 |         139255 |                   110660 |                    28595 |
| malecns   |  165122 |              10001 |         1471062202 | False           |                                      0 |         165122 |                   165122 |                        0 |

FAFB root ids (~7.2e17) exceed 2^53, so any float64 step (CSV read without dtype, pandas NaN-upcast on merge, JSON in JS) silently corrupts them. Keep int64 / string end to end.

# Part 2: thresholds, regions and sensory depth

Relative thresholds: edge kept if syn_count / (target's total input in the min1 table) >= x. Central-brain scope = both endpoints have region_group 'central_brain' (top neuropil not optic, not VNC). Optic neuropils: ['AME', 'LA', 'LO', 'LOP', 'ME', 'Optic-unspecified'] (each side).
